name: @arena/capability-routing
description: Arena capability routing — the cross-resource capability-demand compiler and ResourceMatch composition engine (Work Order C015; issue #121; spec/human-escalation-work-items.md C015 row; spec/expert-escalation-api.md ES1.0 Routing generalized beyond experts). Generalizes the C002 DemandProfile discipline to the full capability catalog — human experts, Agent Bodies, tools, scoped knowledge and marketplace artifacts — with versioned resolution policies mapping the eight escalation modes to resource classes (never silent coercion), ranked typed ResourceMatch decisions per class plus typed compositions, per-class feasibility filters (substrate/environment compatibility, availability/entitlement state) and an append-only per-demand decision history. Qualification and performance evidence are INPUT to ranking, never access grants (lock rules 9/35).
